label: She appears
try: PERIMETER as the level begins: half a second in, Vasse appears beside the Nexus, a ring closing on her, while the dialog opens on her own words. Press Esc to close it.

label: Her fall
try: The level made for her return, round 1 started with nothing built. When she falls, a small window opens beside her: her face falls, then the window evaporates, and her dim @ waits beside the Nexus. Watch again with r.

label: Back next round
try: Round 2 opens on The Nexus Pulse restores Vasse beside the Nexus. Press Esc: half a second later she appears beside the Nexus, a ring closing on her, and says a line of her own. Press n: the Pulse says it first, under COMMANDER.

label: Explore her
try: Explore Map on Vasse: her card shows her portrait, built on her @, and a ring of light marks her on the map. Arrow away and back.
